verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar oa(n)kaar sunaiaa|

en.bdb: From one resonance the Oankar-Braham created the whole universe.
The very Oankar assumed the form of millions of universes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਤਤੁ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਲਖ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਅ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j tat utapat lakh trai loa suhaiaa|

en.bdb: Five elements were created, myriads of productions were made and all the three worlds were adorned.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰੀਆਵ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jal thal gir taravar safal dhareeaav chalaiaa|

en.bdb: He created water, earth, mountains, trees and made the holy rivers flow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਲ ਤੁਲ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhareeaau samaau kar til tul na tulaiaa|

en.bdb: He created great oceans that subsume in them myriads of rivers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਇਕ ਅਤੋਲਵੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat ik atolavee lekhaa na likhaiaa|

en.bdb: A fraction of their grandeur cannot be explained. Only nature is infinite whose expanse cannot be counted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai kaadhar kin paiaa ||11||

en.bdb: When nature is unknowable how could its creator be known?
